title: Components for modern web frontends in Go.
excerpt: gsxui is a shadcn-style component set for gsx: copy-in, type-checked, server-rendered. Own the code, style it with Tailwind, ship it.
content_html:
gsxui is a shadcn-style component set for gsx: copy-in, type-checked, server-rendered. Own the code, style it with Tailwind, ship it.

go install github.com/gsxhq/gsxui/cmd/gsxui@latest
gsxui init
gsxui add button
